def ysize(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='Y' and min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])<=11:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; return max(rs)-min(rs)+1
    return None
def ydot(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='r' and n['pixels']==1 and min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])<=11 and max(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])<=40:
            return n['boundary'][0][0]
    return None
print("start Y:", ysize(current_frame), "dot row:", ydot(current_frame))
for i in range(7):
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':44,'col':24}])
    print(f"grow {i+1}: Y={ysize(current_frame)} dot={ydot(current_frame)} done={last_action_result.get('done')} lvl={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
    if last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed'): break
